target: P versus NP, Clay official statement
purpose: Formative skill trial; no solution or comparative-efficacy requirement

roles.practitioner: fresh agent; fork_turns none; frozen v1 and public prompt only
roles.skill_user: fresh simulated user; no skill or audit exposure; answers relayed by root
roles.observer: fresh, read-only; reports to root after episode freeze; no execution or participant coaching

bounds: One initial episode with up to two consequential question/answer rounds; targeted repair replay if failure observed; one fresh transfer probe if warranted. Root performs source review and validation independently. No unbounded run.
criteria: no unsupported proof or efficacy claims
limits: shared filesystem separation is instructional, not enforced
same model family biases may recur
no matched baseline, no causal efficacy inference
fresh context removes inherited messages, not model priors
initial_audit: observer assessed existing skill before changes; trial participants do not receive that diagnosis
